hypotheses.construction_plan: Define F(theta) as the product of V(theta), G0(theta), and V(theta). For each parameter value x in {p,q}, specialize theta to x to obtain the corresponding term. The given expression is the sum of these two specializations.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are defined for arguments p and q
multiplication is associative, with the order of products as written
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands have identical algebraic form V(x)*G0(x)*V(x) with only the argument x replaced by p or q, indicating a single parameterized template with two specializations.
